data.subject: Public-records research for TOWERVIEW
data.body:
Hi,

TOWERVIEW's June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in GYRO, TRC, and ALCO.

A Planning Board agenda from the Town of Smithtown, NY, dated October 7, 2026, mentions Gyrodyne in one public-hearing item (https://smithtownny.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=11582,plainText=false).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
